pattern: SELECT .+ FROM ([A-Za-z0-9_\s]+) JOIN ([A-Za-z0-9_\s]+) ON ([A-Za-z0-9_\s]+\.\w+) = (\w+\.\w+) GROUP BY ([A-Za-z0-9_\s, ]+)
correction: SELECT T1.column1 , T1.column2 FROM Table1 AS T1 JOIN Table2 AS T2 ON T1.common_column = T2.common_column GROUP BY T1.column1

metadata.description: This rule corrects SQL queries where the grouping columns are not correctly specified for a join operation.
